title: Schneider Electric Modicon M221 PLCs and SoMachine Basic (Update A)
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW USE OF HARD-CODED CRYPTOGRAPHIC KEY CWE-321 Project files, including user-defined project passwords, are encrypted with a hardcoded password. CVE-2017-7574 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 10.0 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L ). PROTECTION MECHANISM FAILURE CWE-693 An attacker can send a specifically crafted command via Modbus over TCP port 502 to the logic controller to discover an application protection password. CVE-2017-7575 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 10.0 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L ). RESEARCHER Simon Heming, Maik Brüggemann, Hendrik Schwartke, and Ralf Spenneberg of Open Source Security discovered these vulnerabilities.
